svg.aria-label: Walkthrough of DevTrail architecture, in six steps
svg.font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", "Noto Sans", Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

g.text: Claude Code, Codex or any MCP client creates todos, saves notes and searches the same workspace people use.
People and agents share one record
The web app, REST and MCP all call the same services, so nothing is copied or synced.
Every change lands on a timeline
Database triggers write the history, so no client can forget to log what it did.
Agents hand off; people see it
save_session stores the summary, decisions and next steps that a person opens on the session timeline.
Vector, keyword and entity-graph results are combined with reciprocal rank fusion.
Each hit carries its retrieval path, so a person or agent can check where an answer came from.
PEOPLE AND AGENTS · BROWSER, IOS, ANY MCP CLIENT
DEVTRAIL SERVER · NODE 20 · ONE HONO PROCESS
AI AND INGEST PROVIDERS · CALLED BY THE SERVER
